description: This file contains Playwright test cases that verify the behavior of test.describe.parallel, test.describe.serial, configuration options related to parallel execution, and worker behavior in a Playwright testing environment.

methods.name: test.describe.parallel
methods.description: Defines a suite of tests that should run in parallel, testing its behavior and nesting rules.

methods.name: test.describe.serial
methods.description: Defines a suite of tests that should run serially, used here to test nesting restrictions.

methods.name: test.describe.configure
methods.description: Configures the test suite to run in parallel mode or other options.

methods.name: test.beforeAll
methods.description: Hook for setup code to run before any tests in a suite.

methods.name: test.afterAll
methods.description: Hook for teardown code to run after all tests in a suite.
